changes.evidence: Eyes of Wakanda episode 1 ('Into the Lion's Den'): Akeya is the leader of the Dora Milaje; Noni greets her on screen as 'Akeya, oh great leader of the Dora Milaje', a Dora Milaje guard serves under her, and she offers Noni her place back in the Dora Milaje. Wikipedia cast list: 'The eldest leader of the Dora Milaje and Noni's superior'. The dataset already uses 'The Dora Milaje' (Okoye, Ayo).

Eyes of Wakanda episode 1: the screen tells that Noni is a former Dora Milaje, expelled before 1260 BC (Akeya picks her because she is an expelled soldier the Lion does not know, and promises her place back in the Dora Milaje; at the end Noni refuses that place and joins the War Dogs/Hatut Zaraze). A past group the screen tells counts, keyed first to her first title. Wikipedia: 'A disgraced former member of the Dora Milaje' / 'the former Dora Milaje Noni is tasked by her mentor Akeya'.

Does the mosque count as his workplace group, and under what name? This is the same open question as Nakia Bahadir's mosque-board seat; the fan wiki's name 'Islamic Masjid of Jersey City' is not confirmed as said on screen.
